name: Rillora
subtitle: Your digital life, organized
promotionalText: Keep important accounts and directions organized. Choose what each trusted person can see, and help them find the next step when it matters.
description:
Organize the important details someone may need to find.

Rillora helps you create a private map of accounts, documents, devices, subscriptions and other matters. Record where information is kept, what you want to happen and who can help. Keep passwords and recovery secrets out of your map.

CHOOSE WHAT EACH PERSON SEES
Invite a trusted person with a link or QR code. They accept using their own Rillora account and can view only the matters and detail levels you selected. They can use the web without installing the app. Change or revoke sharing whenever you need to.

FIND THE OFFICIAL NEXT STEP
Read preparation and after-death account guidance for common platforms. Relevant guides appear beside supported accounts, with links to the original provider instructions.

KEEP YOUR PLAN USEFUL
Free includes a lightweight text map, one current-updating recipient, official guidance, data export and account controls. Rillora Family supports up to five current-updating recipients, shared reviews and one designated contributor who can suggest corrections for your approval. Rillora Family is offered as an annual subscription.

KEEP CONTROL OF YOUR INFORMATION
Make a private backup, read supported saved files and manage account deletion from My data. Cancelling Family keeps your own map available under Free. Additional accepted recipients may retain their last authorized paid-period copy, subject to your current privacy restrictions and revocation.

Rillora is an organizer, not a will, password manager or account-transfer service. It does not determine death, grant legal authority or automatically release information when you stop signing in. Third-party account requests remain subject to each provider's requirements.
